body.x: With the support from Daegu Technopark Mobile Convergence Center, AHQLAB (CEO Kim Taeyeon) will participate in the world’s largest technology exhibition CES 2020 opening in Las Vegas on Jan. 7-10 to showcase its diet solution application for the pet dogs and cats Hodu.

In 2016, 54% of dogs and 59% of cats in the United States were found out to be obese. This means that pets' obesity is a serious problem and should be taken care of. To solve this, the company is launching Hodu, so that the petowners can easily make their pets go on diets.

The app Hodu is made by veterinarians, and its professional diet program can be used at affordable prices. The petowners simply record information about the weight, meals, and walks of the dog or cat they are raising, and the app analyzes the data and informs on how much they have grown, and suggests a weekly plan for how much weight to lose and how to lose them. This app will free from looking for hospitals or relying on the Internet to provide treatment for the pets. It provides a diet program that can be easily followed by petowners in a cheaper and more systematic form.

CEO Kim said, "We are planning torelease the application when exhibiting at CES, and we have alreadyexperimented with 1000 dogs and cats. We have received feedback and gainedknow-hows by conducting diet programs for 75 petowners."

Daegu Metropolitan City has supported 196 ICT venture companies and SMEs in the area to enter the market for eight consecutive years since 2013, with the cumulative contract amount of $22.4 million as of 2019.

Daegu Joint Pavilion, organized by Daegu Technopark Mobile Convergence Center, will have 44 ICT convergence ventures and SMEs and three startups. Major programs include exhibitions, investor pitching, public relations with foreign media, and post-CES review conferences. In CES 2019, Daegu and Gyeongbuk Province exchanged MOU to run joint pavilion in CES for the benefits of both parties, and the joint pavilion has been set up in CES 2020. The world’s largest IT show CES shows the trend of the global technology issues and trends at a glance. It is hosted by Consumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January.
